title: IELTS Academic 21 - Listening Test 1 - Part 2
transcriptHtml:
LISTENING TRANSCRIPT - PART 2

💡 Audio-Track Sync: Bấm vào bất kỳ câu nào dưới đây để phát audio ngay đúng câu đó!

07:43ANNOUNCER: You will hear a woman giving advice on a podcast about how to become a makeup artist in the film industry.
07:53ANNOUNCER: First, you have some time to look at questions 11 to 16.
08:48ANNOUNCER: Now listen carefully and answer questions 11 to 16.
09:16WOMAN: Thanks Ian. Well, before you can become a makeup artist on films, you have to spend about two years working as a makeup trainee.
09:26WOMAN: A good place to get your first job would be on a low-budget short film. Of course, this means that you'll be working for free, but it's often worth it for the experience.
09:38WOMAN: Make sure your transport costs are covered, and remember, there's very unlikely to be any catering provided, so bring plenty of food.
09:49WOMAN: If you're lucky, you might start out on a big budget film where you'll get the most useful experience.
09:57WOMAN: On productions like this, makeup and hairstyling are separate departments, so you won't need to bring your curling tongs.
10:06WOMAN: But you're likely to get the opportunity to work with a range of age groups as well as different ethnicities.
10:13WOMAN: Doing makeup for special effects is highly specialized, so don't expect to be offered any practical experience in that.
10:23WOMAN: One problem with working in the makeup department is that it's a high pressure environment. There are very few times when you'll be bored or have nothing to do.
10:33WOMAN: It can be stressful, but you'll see that the top makeup artists are very professional, even when they're having to work with directors who are impatient or unhappy with the makeup artist's work.
10:46WOMAN: Follow your supervisor's lead and try to remain calm at all times.
10:52WOMAN: I have worked with many very famous actors over the years. At first, I found it overwhelming and could hardly speak. I was so in awe.
11:02WOMAN: That's preferable, by the way, to becoming too excited and asking for selfies.
11:08WOMAN: Now, meeting the talent is just a normal part of the job, and to be honest, most actors don't look that special without all the makeup.
11:17WOMAN: Every makeup trainee will need a makeup kit, which they'll be expected to have with them at all times. Just the essentials will do for the kinds of tasks you'll be given. It won't be anything complicated.
11:31WOMAN: It's worth looking at what the other makeup artists have in their kits, but whatever you do, don't borrow anything without asking first.
11:41WOMAN: It's very important to build your portfolio. You should take photos of all the work you do and ideally show the different stages of makeup application if you can.
11:52WOMAN: But remember you'll need to get approval from the makeup designer in charge of the department. As you'll be sending your portfolio digitally, you won't need to get photos printed.
12:06ANNOUNCER: Before you hear the rest of the podcast, you have some time to look at questions 17 to 20.
12:41ANNOUNCER: Now listen and answer questions 17 to 20.
12:49WOMAN: So what does a makeup trainee actually do? You need to think about whether you're the right kind of person to do the job and whether you'd enjoy it. So to give you some idea, here are some of the things you might be required to do.
13:05WOMAN: You may be asked to help prep an actor ready for makeup. Some actors will arrive having already cleansed and moisturized their skin. But sometimes you'll need to step in and get this done without wasting any time. Otherwise, the makeup artist will get behind schedule.
13:25WOMAN: Trainees play a useful role in continuity. It will be your responsibility to take photos, log them digitally, and print out a hard copy to put in each actor's file. This information needs to be kept in good order, as a reshoot can mean replicating makeup months later.
13:47WOMAN: General duties mean doing anything from getting the teas and coffees to putting on a wash. Having a positive attitude and being willing to do whatever is asked of you will help you get your next film job.
14:01WOMAN: You won't be asked to apply makeup to any of the principal cast, only the extras. If there are dozens of extras involved, you'll need to keep up a swift pace and not spend too long on each person. It takes quite a lot of confidence to be able to do this well.
14:18WOMAN: Okay, now about terms and conditions.
14:26ANNOUNCER: That is the end of Part 2.
14:28ANNOUNCER: You now have 30 seconds to check your answers to Part 2.

groups.title: Questions 17–20
groups.instructions:
What requirement or quality does the speaker associate with each of the following duties of a makeup trainee?
Choose FOUR answers from the box and write the correct letter, A–F, next to Questions 17–20.

options.text: Being willing to carry out basic chores

q11.text: What advice does the speaker give about getting a first job on a low-budget film?
options: A. Ensure that travel expenses are paid for.
B. Expect to be provided with free meals on set.
C. Try to gain experience in multiple departments.

steps: • Đáp án đúng: A (Ensure that travel expenses are paid for)
• Dấu hiệu transcript: 'Make sure your transport costs are covered, and remember, there's very unlikely to be any catering provided...'
• Phân tích bẫy: Bài nói 'very unlikely to be any catering provided' (rất khó có đồ ăn sẵn) nên loại phương án B.

q12.text: What is an advantage of starting out on a big-budget film?
options: A. Trainees will gain practical experience in special effects.
B. Trainees can work with people from diverse backgrounds.
C. Trainees are able to learn both makeup and hairstyling.

steps: • Đáp án đúng: B (Trainees can work with people from diverse backgrounds)
• Dấu hiệu transcript: 'you're likely to get the opportunity to work with a range of age groups as well as different ethnicities.'
• Phân tích bẫy: Người nói nêu rõ makeup và hairstyling là hai bộ phận riêng biệt (loại C), và special effects đòi hỏi kỹ thuật cao nên sẽ không được làm (loại A).

q13.text: What does the speaker recommend trainees do when dealing with demanding directors?
options: A. Follow the example set by their senior colleagues.
B. Arrange a private meeting to resolve misunderstandings.
C. Leave the workstation until the atmosphere calms down.

steps: • Đáp án đúng: A (Follow the example set by their senior colleagues)
• Dấu hiệu transcript: 'Follow your supervisor's lead and try to remain calm at all times.'
• Phân tích paraphrase: 'Follow your supervisor's lead' đồng nghĩa với 'follow the example set by senior colleagues'.

q14.text: What does the speaker say about a trainee's behavior around famous actors?
options: A. They should introduce themselves immediately upon arrival.
B. They should ask for photos when the shoot is finished.
C. They should avoid displaying excessive excitement.

steps: • Đáp án đúng: C (They should avoid displaying excessive excitement)
• Dấu hiệu transcript: 'That's preferable, by the way, to becoming too excited and asking for selfies.'
• Phân tích bẫy: Không nên phấn khích xin chụp ảnh selfie (asking for selfies), giữ bình tĩnh hoặc im lặng vẫn tốt hơn.

q15.text: What rule should trainees follow regarding equipment in their makeup kit?
options: A. Purchase tools for every possible scenario.
B. Obtain permission before using items belonging to others.
C. Examine colleagues' kits to find the best brands.

steps: • Đáp án đúng: B (Obtain permission before using items belonging to others)
• Dấu hiệu transcript: 'whatever you do, don't borrow anything without asking first.'
• Phân tích paraphrase: 'without asking first' = 'obtain permission'.

q16.text: What must trainees do before adding photos of their work to their portfolio?
options: A. Have the pictures printed in high resolution.
B. Obtain approval from the head of the department.
C. Ensure each image shows only the final outcome.

steps: • Đáp án đúng: B (Obtain approval from the head of the department)
• Dấu hiệu transcript: 'remember you'll need to get approval from the makeup designer in charge of the department.'
• Phân tích bẫy: Người nói bảo portfolio gửi dạng số (digitally) nên 'won't need to get photos printed' (loại A).
• Đáp án đúng: C (Working quickly and efficiently)
• Dấu hiệu transcript: 'need to step in and get this done without wasting any time. Otherwise, the makeup artist will get behind schedule.'
• Từ khóa đối xứng: 'without wasting any time' = Working quickly.
• Đáp án đúng: B (Keeping accurate records)
• Dấu hiệu transcript: 'take photos, log them digitally, and print out a hard copy to put in each actor's file. This information needs to be kept in good order...'
• Từ khóa đối xứng: 'log them digitally... kept in good order' = Keeping accurate records.
• Đáp án đúng: E (Being willing to carry out basic chores)
• Dấu hiệu transcript: 'getting the teas and coffees to putting on a wash... being willing to do whatever is asked of you...'
• Từ khóa đối xứng: 'teas and coffees... putting on a wash' = basic chores.
• Đáp án đúng: A (Having high self-confidence)
• Dấu hiệu transcript: 'If there are dozens of extras involved... It takes quite a lot of confidence to be able to do this well.'
• Từ khóa đối xứng: 'takes quite a lot of confidence' = Having high self-confidence.
